snippet.title: Tom Felton Reveals His Worst Day on the Harry Potter Set
snippet.description:
Tom Felton, who played Draco Malfoy in the Harry Potter movies, shares a story about his worst day on set, which involved Alan Rickman, who played the iconic character of Professor Snape. Felton recounts a moment when he accidentally stepped on Rickman's cloak, causing the scene to come to a halt. Rickman then scolded Felton for his mistake, leaving him feeling embarrassed and ashamed.

snippet.title: Daniel Radcliffe's stunt double recalls the moment he was paralysed on set
snippet.description:
In this episode of Minutes With, we sat down with Harry Potter stunt performer and remarkable individual, David Holmes. David opens up on his close friendship with Daniel Radcliffe, the magic of being the first person ever to play Quidditch and his fond memories of the Harry Potter sets. David discusses the on-set accident that left him paralysed, speaks on societal attitudes towards those with disabilities and how people can be a force for change in their own lives. 

David Holmes: The Boy Who Lived is out now on Sky Documentaries and streaming service NOW.

snippet.title: Alan Rickman at his best
snippet.description:
Some (hopefully) seamless visual effects make Severus Snape's famous pause about 20 times as long as it is in the actual film. There is obviously a conversation in this scene, but it has been removed via Adobe After Effects. :)

Just for fun. Obviously, I do not own the rights to the film or characters. This is merely a study in visual effects. If you'd like to inquire how it was done, please do so. Chances are, I'll be asked to take it down at some point. :(

Concept by Taylor Scott and Brian Simpson. Execution by Brian Simpson.

snippet.description:
